The Calmont is the steepest vineyard in Europe. Local wineries claim they are harvesting this year earlier than ever before due to increasingly longer and warmer summers. Global warming is creating challenges for local wineries, including more unpredictable weather phenomena. This September was especially wet, causing many ripe grapes to begin to rot. According to estimates by the “Zukunftsinitiative Deutscher Weinbau e. V.” (German Winegrowing Future Initiative), German winegrowing is facing a historic crisis.
